trigger: Multi-hour failure or attack on a shared cloud region, content delivery network, identity service or broadcast satellite distribution path during a major live event
propagation_mechanism: One provider failure propagates simultaneously to streaming, online games, ticketing and news sites that share it
affected_sector_service: Live streaming and catch-up, online game services, ticket sales, news publication
plausible_effects: Lost live audiences, advertiser make-goods and rights-holder disputes, refund and re-sale costs, correlated revenue dips across many counterparties
early_warning_indicators: Provider status incidents; DDoS spikes against media; satellite interference reports; regional cloud impairments
assumptions: Multi-hour outage coinciding with a live event; no data compromise; durations illustrative; no probability assigned
limitations: Both 2025 provider failures were non-malicious and restored within a day; multi-provider designs limit effect

trigger: Ransomware or intrusion at a major broadcaster, news organisation or national cultural institution, or compromise of content-insertion or alerting equipment, during an election or live event
propagation_mechanism: Containment isolates playout, newsroom, ticketing or collection systems; hijacked output or false alerts reach the public
affected_sector_service: Live output, publication, public access to collections and venues, alerting
plausible_effects: Off-air or degraded output, lost advertising and subscriptions, recovery and rebuild cost, regulatory scrutiny, multi-year access loss for legacy estates
early_warning_indicators: Sector incident notices; regulator warnings on content-insertion devices; hacktivist claims; conflict escalation
assumptions: One counterparty affected for days to months; illustrative durations from Dresden, Lee and British Library; no probability assigned
limitations: Manual fallback, segregated playout and physical media can keep output on air

trigger: Compromise of a shared ticketing, collection-management, newsroom, playout, media asset management or managed service provider, or theft of its integration tokens
propagation_mechanism: One supplier incident reaches many institutions and their customers at once
affected_sector_service: Online ticketing and payments, collection and catalogue access, newsroom and playout tools, customer data
plausible_effects: Simultaneous revenue-channel loss, notification and phishing follow-on, supplier disputes, regulatory reviews of customers
early_warning_indicators: Supplier breach notices; regulator or prosecutor statements naming a provider; attacker claims against suppliers
assumptions: Supplier serves hundreds to thousands of institutions; no probability assigned
limitations: Alternative ticket offices, on-site sales and data segregation limit effect
